rule: every slang term used in C2 must carry a defined doctrinal payload from this file; terms marked AVOID are documented with reason, never silently used

terms.means: one who shares your essence; soul sibling, closer than a bro
terms.carries: shared-essence intimacy (svātmamaya, abheda-adjacent). NOT romantic (twin-flame is a foreign doctrine — never import it)
terms.limits: only where the verse claims shared essence/identity. Never for I-Thou refuge verses (v1) or the Lord's transcendence

terms.means: an elder figure who is out of touch; outdated authority
terms.carries: defanged authority — someone whose power over you has expired
terms.limits: only for powers the verse itself dismisses (Death/Yama). Never for Bhairava, Śaṅkara, the devotee, or the teaching

terms.means: steady, committed, undistracted; fully in the zone by choice
terms.carries: dhīra (firmness), sustained practice-state, covenantal commitment. The Śiva-conscious practitioner state
terms.limits: for the practitioner's steadiness/commitment — never for the Lord's nature (He doesn't 'lock in', He IS)
terms.verdict: USE (v2 always-ness, v4 steadiness, v9 covenant)

terms.means: handling your responsibilities, showing up properly
terms.carries: sevanā (service) + dhīra (steady practice) as concurrent discipline
terms.limits: practice verses only

terms.means: truth-staking; I am being fully serious
terms.carries: satyam (truly!) and categorical claims (na jātu — never at all). Epistemic sincerity marker
terms.limits: only where the Sanskrit stakes truth or totality. Never as filler

terms.means: an unavoidable life-defining moment that shapes you
terms.carries: the affliction that triggers transformation (kleśadaśā as condition for tadaiva)
terms.limits: only as trigger, never as the goal; the verse's mechanism must stay intact

terms.means: finished, done for, out of options
terms.carries: the defeat of death-powers (mṛtyu/Yama/antaka neutralized by namas alone)
terms.limits: for defeated threats only — never the devotee, never the Lord

terms.means: executed flawlessly, complete accomplishment
terms.carries: emi (entry accomplished); arrival with nothing left undone
terms.limits: accomplishment moments only; 'no crumbs' = totality (aśeṣam-adjacent)

terms.means: excellent, chiefly of taste/food; top-tier sensory good
terms.carries: amṛta/parāmṛta (nectar) — the taste-domain maps exactly
terms.limits: taste-domain (nectar, bliss-as-flavor) only. Never for persons or doctrines

terms.means: radiating a vibe; X is the energy present
terms.carries: manifest expressive state (dance/song/joy as emitted energy)
terms.limits: descriptive of emitted states only; never for metaphysical claims

terms.means: the established canon; being connected to it
terms.carries: śāstra (scripture as the Lord's own expression) + cintā (dwelling in it)
terms.limits: scripture-contemplation contexts; 'lore' never replaces śāstra, it voices your relation to it

terms.means: delusional, out of touch with reality
terms.carries: moha (delusion) one-to-one
terms.limits: moha contexts only

terms.means: recognized, noticed truly
terms.carries: pratyabhijñā-adjacent recognition (not petition, not inference)
terms.limits: recognition moments; never for discursive reasoning

terms.means: real radiant presence someone carries
terms.carries: śakti as radiance — ONLY where the verse attributes genuine power
terms.limits: NEVER 'aura farming' (performative) for genuine states; never diminishes terror (bhīṣaṇa) into coolness
terms.verdict: HOLD — v4's power is terrifying, not radiant-cool; forcing aura would soften bhīṣaṇa. Documented, unused

terms.means: background extra; someone who doesn't matter
terms.carries: nothing in this stotra — anyajanāḥ (others) areTA denied access (durlabham), never declared worthless
terms.limits: BANNED here: contempt is not in the verse

terms.means: self-centered protagonist energy
terms.carries: nothing — the stotra's center is the Lord, and the devotee's joy is relational
terms.limits: BANNED: imports ego-doctrine foreign to the text

terms.means: transformation into a better version
terms.carries: -maya (change of nature) is adjacent BUT implies upgrade-narrative; C1 stresses entry/state over self-improvement arc
terms.limits: BANNED: smuggles self-improvement doctrine

terms.means: excellent, of music
terms.carries: could voice stotra-praise (v7) but claims quality where the verse claims INSTRUMENTALITY — wrong payload
terms.limits: BANNED here: praises the song for slapping when the verse says the song WORKS

terms.means: get real, go outside
terms.carries: nothing precise here — generic grounding advice with no Sanskrit counterpart
terms.limits: BANNED: filler slang with no payload

terms.means: big emotional blowup over something small
terms.carries: tanutāpa is SLIGHT anguish — crash out overshoots the scale 10x
terms.limits: BANNED here: violates the verse's own calibration (tanu)
